components.content: Delivering expert project coordination, commercial precision, and skilled manpower for complex vessel overhauls across Singapore's major shipyards
Extensive experience shifting and refitting heavy cargo systems, including Ebara LNG Cargo Main Pumps, Spray & Stripping Pumps, and High/Low-Duty Regas Pumps.
Overhaul and popping tests for critical safety systems, including EGB Safety Valves (up to DN3250mm), Isolating Valves, and Heating-up Steam Safety Valves
Precision overhauling of Central Fresh Water (CFW) Pumps, Main Engine Lube Oil (LO) Pumps, LO Crosshead Pumps, and ME Jacket FW Pumps
Overhauling of deck equipment, including windlass and mooring winch hydraulic motors. We execute complete anchor system servicing and brake lining replacements
Complete removal and installation of Seawater (SW) Pumps, Bilge Pumps, Water Mist System Pumps, and GW Circulation/Injection Pumps
Servicing of Aft & EOT cranes and monorail hoists. We handle wire rope replacements, brake pad renewals, and complete winch motor overhauls for internal vessel lifting gear.
Expert servicing of Oil Fired Boiler systems, including Steam to Consumers, Boiler Wash, Bottom Blow and Feed Water Inlet valves
End-to-end component restoration, including mechanical seal replacements, shaft alignment, impeller inspections, bearing renewals, and static pressure testing

Established in 1980, Weng Lee Soon Engineering is a premier marine construction and vessel repair contractor based in Singapore. For over four decades, we have built an industry reputation for mechanical precision and operational reliability, serving as a trusted partner to major shipyards for complex vessel installations, overhauls, and repairs. Having successfully serviced over 500 vessels ranging from commercial LNG tankers to complex FPSO conversions and major new builds, we deliver the turnkey mechanical solutions that keep maritime operations moving.

Our core strength lies in our highly deployable workforce of over 150 skilled marine specialists and our uncompromising commitment to safety. We specialize in the complete removal, overhauling, and refitting of critical shipboard systems, including LNG and cargo pumps, boiler mounting valves, deck winches, and overhead cranes. Operating heavily within top-tier facilities like Seatrium Tuas Boulevard Yard, our mechanical teams are fully certified to execute high-stakes equipment servicing to exacting international marine standards.
